text: I wish I could write you every day, more than once, for although I have a number of friends and many relations who are very dear to me, yet all the friendship I have for others is far unequal to that which warms my heart for you.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 80, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, 3 December, 1775
